enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Off hides the Crystal Ball button on every client, and the Seer answers no one; the sittings it has kept stay where they are.

serviceUrl.name: Service URL
serviceUrl.hint: Where the window reaches the Seer: a path on this server (the default, /crystalball, when the server routes it to the Seer) or a full URL (on a local test table, http://localhost:30001/crystalball).

tableNotes.name: Table notes
tableNotes.hint: Your standing notes to the ball, added to its instructions for every player who asks: its manner, what it should decline, the table's house facts.

askers.name: Who may ask
askers.hint: Every user, or only the users listed below.

askerIds.name: Listed users
askerIds.hint: When Who may ask is set to the listed users: their user ids, separated by commas.

rulebooks.name: Rulebooks
rulebooks.hint: The compendium packs the ball may look rules up in, one pack id a line (the Player's Handbook's spells are dnd-players-handbook.spells). Journal and item packs only, never monsters; each player reads only the packs open to them. Leave it empty and the ball looks nothing up.

rulebookLeaveOut.name: Left out of the rulebooks
rulebookLeaveOut.hint: Folders, journal entries and pages the ball never reads in those packs, one name a line: the creatures, an adventure, anything you keep for yourself. Lead a line with a book's id and a colon to leave a name out of that book alone (dnd-arcana-unleashed: Chapter 5), since books share chapter names.

gmGaze.name: The GM's gaze
gmGaze.hint: What the ball knows when a GM asks: what the players can see plus the GM's own pages (so you test what your players get), or everything in the world.

stir: The mists inside the glass stir and part.
A pale light wakes in the heart of the ball.
The glass clouds, then clears like still water.
Something old turns over in the depths of the crystal.
Smoke curls within the orb and settles into shapes.
The ball hums, low, as if it had been waiting.
Starlight gathers where there should be none.
Your reflection fades, and something else looks back.
The crystal grows cold beneath your fingers.
A slow tide of silver washes across the glass.
The candle gutters; the orb does not.
Faint whispers rise from the glass, and fall silent.
sight: It sees what {name} has seen, and remembers what {name} has read.
It knows the pages you could turn yourself, and no more.
Your companions' deeds glimmer in its depths.
The clues you gathered drift through the fog like embers.
It holds your story, written in your own hand and others'.
What the party has found, the ball has kept.
It reads no secrets but the ones you already hold.
Old roads and half-heard names wait in the haze.
It knows the weight of your pack and the scars on your shield.
Every mystery the party has pinned shines faintly within.
The glass remembers what {name} would rather forget.
Threads of what you know weave and unweave in the light.
ask: Ask plainly; the ball dislikes riddles that are not its own.
One question, then another; the ball is patient.
Say what you seek, and it will look.

fvtt-mod-crystalball.long: The vision faded before the end; ask the ball to go on.

lookup.search: The ball leafs through the rulebooks…

export.hint: Export this sitting as a Markdown file
export.title: The Crystal Ball: {name}
export.none: Nothing in this sitting to export yet.

copy.failed: The browser would not copy it; select the words and copy them instead.

fvtt-mod-crystalball.newSittingHint: Close this sitting (the DM keeps it) and start a fresh one

input.label: Your question to the ball
input.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line

dark.unreachable: The ball is dark: the Seer, the service that answers it, cannot be reached.
dark.foundry: The ball is dark: the Seer has lost its link to this world.
dark.world: The ball is dark: the Seer sees no open world.

errors.unknownSession: The ball does not know you: your session was not recognised. Reload Foundry and ask again.
errors.notAllowed: The ball is not yours to ask in this world; the DM decides who may.
errors.tooLong: That is too long for the ball: {limit} characters at most.

limit.hour: You have asked the ball enough for this hour. Ask again in {wait}.
limit.day: You have asked the ball enough for today. Ask again in {wait}.
limit.tableDay: The table has spent today's gazing. The ball clears again in {wait}.
limit.tableMonth: The table has spent this month's gazing. The ball clears again in {wait}.

dark.foundryDisconnected: The ball clouded over: the Seer lost its link to the world. Try again in a moment.
dark.worldClosed: The ball clouded over: the world is not open.
dark.model: The ball clouded over before it could answer. Try again.

errors.network: The ball could not reach the Seer. Try again.
errors.cut: The answer was cut off before it finished.
errors.timeout: The ball took too long to answer.
